summary: I built FirePulse MY & ASEAN, a web app that merges NASA’s MODIS and VIIRS fire data into one simple Burning Activity Calendar. Users can filter across five regions in Malaysia, Borneo, and Sumatra, drop in NASA FIRMS CSVs for instant updates, and export daily incident reports with clear haze advisories.
details:
I built FirePulse MY & ASEAN to combine NASA’s MODIS (1 km) and VIIRS (375 m) fire data into one simple Burning Activity Calendar. Because VIIRS detects way more small fires than MODIS, my app standardizes both sensors onto a shared 0–100 index across Malaysia, Borneo, and Sumatra so responders and communities can spot unusual fire and haze spikes early. Users can also drop in NASA FIRMS CSV files for instant updates and export daily incident reports.
Built with React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and Vite using NASA FIRMS data (MODIS & VIIRS) and Canva for slides. Per 2026 rules, Bolt AI was used to help build the UI code while I handled the data logic and testing myself (no NASA logos used).
